features: Apple Music SF Pro & SF Pro Display typography across all screens, bottom sheets, and fullview player
Balanced medium and semibold weights across tracks, subtitles, and lyrics (no hairline fonts)
Tabular figures on track rankings, countdown timers, and listening insights metrics
fixes: Replaced all remaining GoogleFonts/Inter typography on album, artist, login, insights, settings, and action sheets
Fixed Dynamic Island notification body fallback to render native SF Pro
Unified fullview player, miniplayer, queue panel, and studio FX typography weights
improvements: Removed google_fonts dependency for smaller APK footprint and instant offline font loading
Sub-millisecond audio streaming demuxing and pristine 320kbps Akamai CDN playback
Optimized background battery drain with screen-off animation/visualizer suspension
releaseNotes:
• Complete Apple Music SF Pro typography across every screen, modal sheet, login & fullview player
• Clean medium & semibold weights (no thin/washed-out fonts)
• Removed google_fonts bloat for faster cold start & smaller APK
• Background playback & battery optimizations
message: Update to v1.0.8 for complete Apple Music SF Pro typography and performance improvements
